description: Hand-derived 17-op canonical Qwen2.5-3B layer DAG template. Maps each semantic operator to its engine, shape decomposition formula, and dependency edges for critical-path reduction. Derived from docs/qwen25-3b-forward-spec.md. 9 MXU + 5 SFU + 3 Vector.

ops.name: Q_proj
ops.shape_decomp: M=batch_m, K=hidden, N=heads*head_dim; M_tiles=ceil(M/64), K_tiles=ceil(K/64), N_tiles=ceil(N/64); cycle_formula: M==1?decode_interleaving:prefill_model

ops.name: K_proj
ops.shape_decomp: M=batch_m, K=hidden, N=kv_heads*head_dim; K_tiles=ceil(K/64), N_tiles=ceil(N/64); cycle_formula: M==1?decode_interleaving:prefill_model

ops.name: V_proj
ops.shape_decomp: M=batch_m, K=hidden, N=kv_heads*head_dim; K_tiles=ceil(K/64), N_tiles=ceil(N/64); cycle_formula: M==1?decode_interleaving:prefill_model

ops.name: RoPE
ops.shape_decomp: elements=heads*head_dim; batches=ceil(elements/sfu_width); cycles=pipeline_depth(rmsnorm)*batches for RoPE is rope: pipeline=82

ops.name: attention_QK
ops.shape_decomp: M=batch_m, K=head_dim, N=context_len; K_tiles=ceil(K/64), N_tiles=ceil(N/64); cycle_formula: M==1?decode_interleaving:prefill_model

ops.name: attention_PV
ops.shape_decomp: M=batch_m, K=context_len, N=head_dim*heads; K_tiles=ceil(K/64), N_tiles=ceil(N/64); cycle_formula: M==1?decode_interleaving:prefill_model

ops.name: O_proj
ops.shape_decomp: M=batch_m, K=heads*head_dim, N=hidden; K_tiles=ceil(K/64), N_tiles=ceil(N/64); cycle_formula: M==1?decode_interleaving:prefill_model

ops.name: FFN_gate
ops.shape_decomp: M=batch_m, K=hidden, N=intermediate; K_tiles=ceil(K/64), N_tiles=ceil(N/64); cycle_formula: M==1?decode_interleaving:prefill_model

ops.name: FFN_up
ops.shape_decomp: M=batch_m, K=hidden, N=intermediate; K_tiles=ceil(K/64), N_tiles=ceil(N/64); cycle_formula: M==1?decode_interleaving:prefill_model

ops.name: FFN_down
ops.shape_decomp: M=batch_m, K=intermediate, N=hidden; K_tiles=ceil(K/64), N_tiles=ceil(N/64); cycle_formula: M==1?decode_interleaving:prefill_model

parallel_chains.description: Q/K/V projections are independent and can execute in parallel
FFN gate and up projections are independent and can execute in parallel

serialized_bottlenecks.description: Attention matmul chain: QK→softmax→PV, must be serialized due to data dependency
FFN: gate+up project→SiLU+mul→down project, parallel project branches must converge at op_14
